verdict.rationale: Fin's own page (fin.ai/cli) describes an official Fin CLI built for AI-native workflows: users point their AI coding agent at it to set up Fin on a website and configure the Intercom helpdesk without leaving the coding environment. The evidence is a single marketing-level statement, so depth and real-world reliability are unverified. Missing for 10: command reference or installation docs, scope of CLI operations beyond setup and configuration, any GitHub repo or package for the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
